scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 dist/main/main/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electronmon dist/main/main/main.js
scripts.dev:counter:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 dist/main/main/counterMain.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electronmon dist/main/main/counterMain.js
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && electron-builder
scripts.test: npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/shared/*.test.js dist-test/shared/lesson/*.test.js
scripts.check:audio: npm test && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.check:games: tsc -p tsconfig.final-boss.json && node --test games/language-snake/inputBridge.test.mjs games/final-boss-hero/hostBridge.test.mjs games/final-boss-hero/projectRoundTrip.test.cjs games/final-boss-hero/editorImport.test.cjs games/final-boss-hero/observePlayArea.test.cjs games/final-boss-hero/fitPlayArea.test.cjs games/final-boss-hero/boardProjection.test.cjs games/shared/hostedScheduler.test.mjs games/shared/hostedBridge.test.mjs games/language-snake/hostedConfig.test.mjs games/final-boss-hero/hostedAdapter.test.cjs
scripts.check:release: npm run check:audio && npm run check:games
scripts.test:translation: node --test scripts/translation-cache.test.cjs scripts/translation-capture.test.cjs scripts/translation-service.test.cjs scripts/whisper-backend.test.cjs scripts/whisper-runtime.test.cjs scripts/whisper-host.test.cjs scripts/whisper-session.test.cjs
